iis_infant_series_rate.long_name: Iowa IRIS: 4:3:1:3:3:1:4 series completion rate among 2-year-olds, by county
iis_infant_series_rate.short_description: Percentage of Iowa 2-year-old children who completed the recommended 4:3:1:3:3:1:4 immunization series, by county.
iis_infant_series_rate.long_description: Percentage of children turning 2 years old in the survey year who received all recommended doses: 4 DTaP, 3 Polio, 1 MMR, 3 Hib, 3 Hepatitis B, 1 Varicella, and 4 PCV (4:3:1:3:3:1:4 series). Data come from Iowa's IRIS (Immunization Registry Information System) and are reported via the Iowa Public Health Tracking Portal Tableau dashboard. County-level rates are derived from the Tableau CSV export.
iis_infant_series_rate.statement: In {location}, {value}% of 2-year-olds completed the recommended immunization series.

ia_iris.name: Iowa Immunization Registry Information System (IRIS)
ia_iris.organization: Iowa Department of Health and Human Services (Iowa HHS)
ia_iris.location: Iowa Public Health Tracking Portal - Childhood Immunization Data Dashboard
ia_iris.description: County-level immunization rates for 2-year-old children derived from Iowa's IRIS (Immunization Registry Information System). The data show the percentage of children who turned 2 years old in the survey year and received all doses of 7 routinely recommended vaccines (DTaP, Polio, MMR, Hib, Hepatitis B, Varicella, PCV) and the combined 4:3:1:3:3:1:4 series. Data are accessed via the Tableau dashboard hosted on the Iowa IDPH server (data.idph.state.ia.us), which requires an SSL bypass (self-signed certificate) and a session cookie from an initial page load. The server returns empty data without a valid session.
ia_iris.restrictions: Public domain. Iowa HHS data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
